biothings.name: familial nephrotic syndrome
biothings.definition: An instance of nephrotic syndrome that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome. [MONDO:patterns/hereditary]
biothings.synonyms: congenital nephrotic syndrome, hereditary nephrotic syndrome

biothings.name: nephrotic syndrome
biothings.definition: A collection of symptoms that include severe edema, proteinuria, and hypoalbuminemia; it is indicative of renal dysfunction. [NCIT:C34845]
biothings.synonyms: nephrotic syndrome, nephrotic syndromes, syndrome, nephrotic, syndromes, nephrotic

biothings.name: nephrotic syndrome, type 13
biothings.definition: Any familial nephrotic syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the NUP205 gene. [MONDO:patterns/disease_series_by_gene]
biothings.synonyms: familial nephrotic syndrome caused by mutation in NUP205, nephrotic syndrome, type 13, nephrotic syndrome, type 13; NPHS13, NPHS13, NUP205 familial nephrotic syndrome

Cataracts, hearing impairment, nephrotic syndrome, and enterocolitis

opentargets.name: nephrotic syndrome
opentargets.description: A collection of symptoms that include severe edema, proteinuria, and hypoalbuminemia; it is indicative of renal dysfunction.

opentargets.name: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome
opentargets.description: Nephrotic syndrome, occurring in the pediatric population, in which proteinuria does not normalize with administration of steroids; this condition is unresponsive to a minimum of four weeks administration of oral corticosteroids.

opentargets.name: familial nephrotic syndrome
opentargets.description: An instance of nephrotic syndrome that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

opentargets.name: familial idiopathic steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome
opentargets.description: Familial idiopathic steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome is characterized by a nephrotic syndrome with often early onset.

opentargets.name: idiopathic nephrotic syndrome
opentargets.description: Nephrotic syndrome for which no cause has been identified.
